name: koralpaper
description: Let Claude design diagrams directly on your KoralPaper paper.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the KoralPaper app running in your browser. Describe a diagram in plain words and Claude draws it as fully editable hand-drawn-style elements: flowcharts, carousels, decision trees. Claude can also read the current page, look at a rendered picture of it, and tidy or restyle what is already there. Nothing leaves your machine except your conversation with Claude.

tools.name: koralpaper_status
tools.description: Check whether the KoralPaper app is open and linked.

tools.name: koralpaper_read_document
tools.description: Read every page and element of the current document.

tools.name: koralpaper_create_page
tools.description: Create a new page and draw editable elements on it.

tools.name: koralpaper_add_elements
tools.description: Add elements to the current page.

tools.name: koralpaper_delete_elements
tools.description: Delete elements from the current page by id.

tools.name: koralpaper_render_page
tools.description: Render the current page as an image to verify the layout.
